description: Reconciliation of ROC-derived operating threshold: 1.4889 vs 1.6040

empirical_roc_1pct_fpr.definition: Operating point on empirical test ROC curve where test FPR <= 1.00% (<= 15 false positives out of 1500 negatives)

frozen_validation_calibrated_threshold.definition: Fixed operating point calibrated strictly on 300 validation negatives targeting 1.0% nominal validation FPR

reconciliation_of_1_4889.origin: In the negative score distribution of 1500 test negatives, 1.4889-1.4920 corresponds to the 98.0th percentile (i.e., FPR = 2.00%, threshold = 1.49197). An early draft conflated the 98th percentile with the 99th percentile, or cited an interpolated operating point. On the authoritative test set, the exact empirical threshold for 1.00% FPR (15/1500 false positives) is 1.6040.
